summary: Prudential plc (6-K) disclosed ongoing on-market share repurchases of its ordinary 5p shares, executed by JP Morgan Securities plc under buy-back authorities from the 2025 and 2026 AGMs. The company repurchased 2,367,089 shares on the London Stock Exchange between 1-4 September 2026 at prices from £9.9060 to £10.4700 per share and intends to cancel the repurchased shares. Aggregate purchases since programme commencement (6 January 2026 and 2 September 2026) total 61,118,411 shares at a volume-weighted average price of 1,080.7512p. Post-transaction, shares in issue are 2,492,828,558. No advisor, premium, or break fee disclosed. Watch for continued daily repurchase disclosures and potential share cancellation impacts on per-share metrics.
